title: 8 March 2026
description:
⏰ We Arrived at the Airport 40 Minutes Before Our Flight. WITH KIDS. Here’s What Happened… 😱✈️

You read that right.
F-O-R-T-Y.
As in less than one full Bluey episode.
As in “should-we-just-cancel-the-trip?” panic. 😅

We were flying out of Singapore Changi Airport with our kids…
And by the time we got there, we had exactly 40 minutes left until takeoff.
No express line. No VIP pass. Just a backpack full of snacks and hope.

But guess what?
✨NOTHING WENT WRONG.✨

We breezed through check-in, security, and even had time for a potty stop (which, if you’ve ever traveled with children, you know is basically a miracle).

So how did we pull off this stress-free miracle?

🎯 We asked our hotel concierge before the flight.
And they confidently told us:
“At Changi, 1–1.5 hours is more than enough. It’s one of the most efficient airports in the world.”

And friends… they were not lying.

BUT HOLD UP. ⚠️
This isn’t a green light to cut it that close at every airport.
We normally give ourselves:
🧳 2 hours for domestic flights
🛫 3 hours (at least!) for international flights

Because we’ve seen too many families denied check-in at the counter for showing up late — especially with stricter airlines and bigger, slower airports (we’re looking at you, LAX and Manila 😅).

👀 What’s the least amount of time you’ve had to make a flight? Did it end in ✈️ or 💔?
